speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
title: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Gerrit W. Gong spoke about “Come to the Lord in His Holy House”.

quotes.text: In our day, the Lord is bringing His holy house and covenant blessings closer to our homes and hearts. Foundational doctrine can deepen our love for the Lord. It can increase our understanding of the temple and personal temple culture.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Second doctrinal foundation: moral agency. The morning stars sang for joy. We chose God our Father’s loving plan to learn by our own experience. Jesus Christ redeems us from sin, physical death, and spiritual separation.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Agency, faith and repentance, and Jesus Christ’s Atonement make change and forgiveness possible. As we become new creatures in Jesus Christ, we sweeten our relationships. Temple service evokes our Savior’s Atonement. It softens hearts on both sides of the veil.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Rich blessings await. Please “do not procrastinate the day of your repentance until the end.” Please do not deliberately delay the spiritual peace and joyful freedom Jesus Christ wants you to have now.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Third doctrinal foundation: When the Holy Spirit of Promise witnesses and confirms the efficacy of ordinances and covenants, they become binding in time and eternity. In His sacred role as Holy Spirit of Promise, the Holy Ghost “witnesses to the Father that the saving ordinances have been performed properly and that the covenants associated with them have been kept.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Dallin H. Oaks exercises all priesthood keys on earth, including keys pertaining to temples. Next Sunday, I am assigned to dedicate the Miraflores Guatemala City Temple. This year, across the world, we anticipate the First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve Apostles will dedicate 21 temples and rededicate 1 temple.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Third, while each temple uniquely fits its place, culture, and circumstance, everything in each temple testifies of Jesus Christ. Temple leaders unitedly love the Lord and focus on temple patrons and workers. In each temple, by authority and in the name of the Lord, ordinances and covenants are truly and faithfully performed and properly recorded. When patrons do their best, our service is acceptable to the Lord.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Fourth, temple sacrifice and temple service include a spirit of gratitude. I mention this with great respect and love. On occasion, a few members may think attending the temple is a right or entitlement rather than a sacred privilege and may be impatient or not understand when assistance comes slowly or is less than they want.
quotes.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
